name: colab-gpu-status
description: Displays live Google Colab GPU and VRAM metrics in the VS Code status bar with one-click runtime provisioning and stop controls.

colabStatus.colabPath.description: Path to the colab CLI executable. Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH or ~/.local/bin/colab.

colabStatus.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to run the bundled status query script.

colabStatus.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Polling interval in seconds for checking Colab session and VRAM status.
